svg.title: Claude Memory Sync System architecture
svg.desc: MSI GE73VR primary machine and ThinkPad T480 travel machine each run claude_sync.py and api_sync.py, kept alive by systemd and cron. Both sync context to Proton Drive via rclone every 30 minutes. Startup context flows up to Claude AI.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Claude AI use startup context from the memory sync system?')
sendPrompt('What does claude_sync.py do and how does the heartbeat work?')
sendPrompt('What does api_sync.py do and how does it generate startup context via the Claude API?')
sendPrompt('How do systemd and cron automate the memory sync on boot and every 30 minutes?')
sendPrompt('What files and subdirectories are stored in the claude-memory folder on the MSI?')
sendPrompt('What does claude_sync.py do and how does the heartbeat work?')

sendPrompt('How do systemd and cron automate the memory sync on boot and every 30 minutes?')
sendPrompt('What files and subdirectories are stored in the claude-memory folder on the ThinkPad?')
sendPrompt('How does Proton Drive provide encrypted cloud sync in the memory system?')
